speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Posterior Hip Dislocation (Right).

The classic presentation of a right leg that is shortened, flexed, adducted, and internally rotated following a rear-end collision is pathognomonic for a posterior hip dislocation. The severe groin pain and inability to bear weight confirm the joint is no longer in its normal position. Immediate surgical reduction is required to prevent avascular necrosis of the femoral head.
